The app-server row combines library **464/0**, binary **4/0**, and integration **1725/1**. Its **13 CLI-dependent exclusions** are additional unexecuted coverage, listed below; they are not passes. Other rows have no exclusions beyond existing ignores.

Mechanical failures repaired in focused sync PRs:

- #2550: exec-server CLI help uses the existing Corbanu config path. The original version test confused unpackaged source metadata with release metadata; it now retains the packaged-version assertion through a real package fixture and adds source-version coverage. Final package **35/0, no skips**, including both sandbox branches; strict test Clippy clean.
- #2552: two Linux tests located fixtures under `TMPDIR` while explicitly testing `/tmp` policy. Final full package under outside-`/tmp` TMPDIR **374/0, 3 existing ignores**; strict test Clippy clean. All masking/registry/metadata assertions retained; no production policy change.

All other historical non-CLI failures in this issue passed the fresh baseline, including exec-server (769/0), exec (211/0), history-notes (10/0), and app-server library (464/0). Exact-head independent Opus reviews and completed CI gates are recorded on the PRs, with corbanu-security approval for #2552. CI reds are only the documented #2274 CLI-marker failures.

**Remaining scope: blocked by #2274.** The one executed failure is `suite::v2::selected_capability_stack::selected_capability_stack_tracks_environment_selection_and_resume`. Its `spawn_exec_server` helper still requires `cargo_bin("codex")`; missing CLI startup causes mock verification to report incomplete requests. Preserve the existing CLI contributor hold; no CLI/helper implementation is duplicated here. These 13 additional app cases remain unexecuted:

This issue stays open for those 14 app cases after the CLI lands. The four MCP/RMCP CLI cases remain separately in #2051. No claim is made that the full CLI, historical core/TUI integration tails, or final sync security gates are qualified.

Reproducible baseline evidence: `tmp/astra-syncissues/astra-syncissues-baseline-evidence.tar.gz`, SHA-256 `1ee5d6dba4a614a0e320bbccc80832aace6fb3f1c36b18608a1aaff292e94d4d`; includes source revisions, invocations, per-test events, summaries and all prior diagnostic attempts. Subsequent focused test/review/CI logs are retained in the same evidence directory. A runtime PATH issue initially affected insta metadata discovery; the pinned-1.99.1 rerun passed the unchanged snapshot. No assertion was relaxed to clear it.
